steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: On 29 October 1929, the American stock market crashed (Wall Street Crash). American banks recalled loans from Germany, causing economic collapse. By 1932, 6 million Germans were unemployed (over 30% of the workforce), and industrial production fell by 58% from its 1929 level. | Key Fact: In the 1928 election, the Nazis won just 2.6% of the vote (12 seats). By July 1932, they were the largest party with 37.3% of the vote (230 seats). This extraordinary rise was driven by the economic crisis and the failure of mainstream parties to solve it. | Key Fact: The Nazis were NOT primarily a working-class party.
